t1.text: Live home, phone 390. Four states the app picks itself

t2.text: Match page and Talk, phone. Fold marked at 844

t3.text: Desktop 1440. Home, then the match panel over the right column

t4.text: Visual system, and the V2 shell around a V1 screen

s1.text: First open, no splash. The screen is the announcement: the spotlight fills the top half with a hero score and a ticking lime minute, the list is dense beneath it, nothing is boxed. One dismissible line under the header says you are on the new Kickoff Draft and where the switch back lives.

s2.text: Above the fold is built from P1 items only. P2 and P3 items (win chances, injuries, fantasy overlay, win-probability line, fan vote) are drawn below the fold or marked so the build order is visible.

s3.text: Shell seam, phase 1. The V2 shell owns the header, the bottom nav and the sub-tab row (text toggles replace the V1 pills, violet underline for Fantasy). Inside it the V1 screen renders as it is: italic uppercase heading, 14px cards, pill buttons. Cheap token swaps the shell can apply: card radius 14 to 12, pill buttons to 8px. Left alone in phase 1: the pitch and bench cards.
